errors.text_span: секторите визуално изглеждат подредени по намаляващ дял (45%, 32%, 15%, 8%)
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are visually ordered by decreasing share, but they are not. Starting from the largest slice (45% at the bottom) and moving clockwise, the sequence of percentages is 45%, 15%, 8%, and 32%, which is not a descending order.
